# Code of Conduct

Be respectful. Assume good faith, keep feedback about the work, and don't harass anyone.

Maintainers may remove comments, close issues, or block users who break this. Report problems privately to gerardrecinto@gmail.com.

This project follows the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
